# video-shotcraft (vendored reference library)

Source: https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft, commit `1266a3e`, copied 2026-11-22 from the copy used for the vin2win promos.
Licence: Apache-2.0, see `LICENSE` in this folder. Attribution for individual shots: `references/shots/ATTRIBUTION.md`.

Taken: `SKILL.md`, `README.md`, `README_RU.md`, `references/` (shot recipe cards, aesthetic rules R/Q/S/C/P, pipeline, sound design) and the TypeScript sources of `demos/`, which hold the tuned timings each card refers to.
Left out: media, gallery, template project, workbench and tooling.

This is a reference, not a pipeline. The cards are tuned for 1920×1080 product promos; content-maker adapts the ones that work in 9:16 with a voice into engine components (`src/editorial/engine/scenes/custom/Keynote.tsx`). Read `docs/KEYNOTE_DIRECTION.md` first.

Changes: none to the copied files.
